title: Morphological characteristics of corneal stromal stem cells and their age-related decline
task: Characterize stromal stem cell morphology and age-related decline in corneal limbus
key_results: SSC numbers and morphological features decline by age 2 years in mice; SSCs localize to anterior stroma with epithelial-like features suggesting mesenchymal–epithelial transition
comments: Spatial organization and niche interactions are well-characterized, but functional mechanisms underlying age-related SSC decline remain mechanistically unspecified.

hypotheses.hypothesis: SSCs in anterior stroma undergo mesenchymal–epithelial transition-like process within limbal niche
hypotheses.result: Subset of SSCs displays epithelial stem cell-like features; confirmed by morphological analysis

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aging reduces SSC regenerative capacity in limbal niche
hypotheses.result: Reduced SSC numbers and morphological alterations observed at 2 years

title: Metastatic promoting role of mesenchymal stem cells in oral squamous cell carcinoma revealed by an improved bone marrow chimeric model
task: Elucidate MSC-mediated regulation of tumor immunity, angiogenesis, and metastasis in OSCC
key_results: Lung metastasis occurred only in MSC-rich mice; LepR signaling inhibition paradoxically increased metastasis; MSC-rich tumors showed enhanced vascularization and adaptive immune infiltration
comments: The context-dependent dual functions of MSCs and unexpected pro-metastatic effect of LepR inhibition suggest complex, potentially redundant signaling mechanisms that warrant further investigation.

model_io.model: GFP bone marrow chimeric mice with OSCC xenograft

hypotheses.hypothesis: MSC abundance directly promotes lung metastasis in OSCC
hypotheses.result: Lung metastasis occurred only in MSC-rich mice, accompanied by bone marrow–derived endothelial activation and TNF-α–driven inflammation

hypotheses.hypothesis: LepR signaling inhibition reduces metastasis by restricting MSC pro-tumoral functions
hypotheses.result: Pharmacological LepR inhibition (SHU9119) unexpectedly increased metastasis

title: Skeletal rearrangement in Biginelli reaction for the synthesis of chromenoquinoline fused spirohydantoins and their in silico cytotoxicity study
task: Synthesis and in silico cytotoxicity evaluation of spirohydantoin chromenoquinoline compounds
key_results: Novel skeletal rearrangement protocol generating imidazolidine-2,4-dione scaffolds; molecular docking against 18 tumor-associated targets including kinesin Eg5 (PDB: 2IEH) showed strong binding efficiency
comments: In silico predictions lack experimental validation; actual anticancer efficacy remains unconfirmed pending biological assays.

inputs: protein structures (kinesin Eg5 and 17 tumor targets)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Spirohydantoin chromenoquinoline compounds exhibit strong binding to tumor-associated targets, indicating anticancer potential
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in silico; requires experimental validation

title: A multi-modal deep learning framework for enhanced breast cancer diagnosis using mammograms and clinical data
task: Breast cancer diagnosis from multimodal mammograms and clinical data
key_results: 94.6% classification accuracy (95% CI: 92.8–96.4%), AUC 0.963 (95% CI: 0.951–0.975), statistically superior to baselines (p < 0.01)
comments: Clinical data were synthetic, limiting real-world applicability; hierarchical fusion with attention mechanisms shows promise but requires validation on genuine paired datasets.

model_io.model: Hierarchical fusion deep learning with cross-modal attention

hypotheses.hypothesis: Integration of mammographic and clinical data via attention-weighted fusion improves diagnostic accuracy over unimodal baselines
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; multimodal framework achieves significantly higher accuracy and AUC

title: Structure-aware 3D diffusion generation for kidney MRI via mask-guided noise scheduling and topology-prior constraints
task: Structure-aware 3D diffusion generation for kidney MRI synthesis
key_results: FID decreased from 18.74 to 11.16, KID from 7.983 to 4.573, PSNR increased from 26.214 to 28.577, LPIPS decreased from 13.442 to 5.7543 compared to baseline; generated data improves downstream segmentation cross-domain robustness
comments: Synthetic MRI generation with topology constraints is technically solid, but clinical utility depends on validation across diverse renal pathologies and scanner protocols.

model_io.model: Structure-aware 3D diffusion model with mask-guided noise scheduling and topology-prior constraints
inputs: distance fields, boundary cues, skeleton information

hypotheses.hypothesis: Incorporating structural priors (noise scheduling and topology constraints) improves 3D medical image generation quality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; both constraints individually improve FID/KID; combined effect is additive

hypotheses.hypothesis: Synthetic MRI data with structural consistency improves segmentation model robustness in cross-domain transfer
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; pre-training on generated data enhances real-data segmentation

title: An effective two-stage key frame extraction method for speech-visual emotion recognition
task: Speech-visual emotion recognition via two-stage key frame extraction
key_results: Proposed method demonstrates superior inference and generalization performance on RML, eNTERFACE05, MEAD, and BAUM-1s datasets; reduces frame redundancy and emotional information loss compared to conventional methods
comments: Information-entropy-based frame selection and modality alignment are conceptually sound, but quantitative performance metrics and statistical significance are not explicitly reported in the abstract.

model_io.model: Two-stage key frame extraction with information entropy and modality alignment
Weighted fusion and emotion recognition classifier

hypotheses.hypothesis: Information entropy-based visual key frame extraction reduces redundancy while preserving emotional information
hypotheses.result: Supported; improves generalization across multiple emotion datasets

hypotheses.hypothesis: Aligning speech and visual key frames leverages cross-modal complementarity to enhance emotion recognition
hypotheses.result: Supported; better inference and generalization reported

title: Reliability and readability of five AI chatbots for concussion health advice across retrieval augmented and pretrained models
task: Evaluation of AI chatbot reliability and readability for concussion health advice
key_results: Perplexity Pro (RAG-based) achieved highest DISCERN (47.36 ± 4.84) and EQIP (65.00 ± 5.48) scores, significantly surpassing ChatGPT and Gemini (p < 0.01); all models exceed 6th-grade reading level, most exceed 10th-grade
comments: RAG architectures improve clinical accuracy but transparency remains uniformly poor across all platforms, necessitating human verification before clinical deployment.

model_io.model: Five AI chatbot platforms (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity Pro, and others)
outputs: text responses evaluated by DISCERN, EQIP, GQS, JAMA transparency metrics and six readability indices

hypotheses.hypothesis: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) models provide higher clinical accuracy than pre-trained LLMs for concussion advice
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Perplexity Pro (RAG) statistically superior to standard models

hypotheses.hypothesis: AI chatbot readability differs significantly across platforms
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; most models exceed 10th-grade reading level; transparency uniformly low

title: Physics-informed Koopman learning approach for fixed-time synchronization of stochastic neural dynamics
task: Fixed-time synchronization of stochastic HR neurons using physics-informed Koopman learning
key_results: Non-singular fixed-time controller designed with pre-determined settling time independent of initial error; dynamic event-triggering mechanism handles bandwidth constraints
comments: Combines physics-informed dictionary design with Koopman operator theory elegantly, but lacks numerical comparison with baseline synchronization methods.

model_io.model: Physics-informed Koopman operator framework with dynamic event-triggering
inputs: mixed Gaussian and Poisson jump noise

hypotheses.hypothesis: Physics-informed lifting dictionary improves fixed-time synchronization over generic basis functions
hypotheses.result: Supported by theoretical design; numerical validation pending explicit comparison

title: Advanced security in fog environments using encryption and adaptive user activity tracking
task: Secure data encryption and user activity tracking in fog computing
key_results: 43.39% faster encryption, 66% faster decryption, 19.86% higher throughput vs. competing methods
comments: Performance improvements are concrete but the security claims lack formal verification; integration of AES-256, SHA-512, and activity tracking is straightforward rather than novel.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combining AES-256 encryption with SHA-512 hashing and activity monitoring mitigates unauthorized data access risks
hypotheses.result: Supported by design; no formal security proof provided

title: Event-triggered mixed $$H_{\infty }$$ and passive control of networked switched systems subject to actuator failures
task: Event-triggered mixed H∞ and passive control of networked switched systems with actuator failures
key_results: Sufficient criteria for exponential stability and weighted mixed H∞/passivity performance index derived; numerical example demonstrates effectiveness
comments: Theoretical contribution is solid but lacks quantitative performance metrics or comparison with existing control schemes; result is existence of controller rather than explicit control gains.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Event-triggered transmission protocol with state-feedback control achieves exponential stability under time-varying delays and actuator failures
hypotheses.result: Proven via Lyapunov-Krasovskii functionals and sufficient conditions
